mapper.select: SELECT id, scenario_id, layout_json, layout_version, version_no, domain, create_time, update_time FROM #{schema}.ecos_scenario_canvas_layout WHERE scenario_id = #{scenarioId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY update_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO #{schema}.ecos_scenario_canvas_layout (id, scenario_id, layout_json, layout_version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, is_deleted, version_no, domain) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.scenarioId}, #{row.layoutJson}, #{row.layoutVersion}, #{row.createBy}, NOW(), #{row.updateBy}, NOW(), 0, 0, #{row.domain})
